newsitem.title: USA: Dow powers to 32nd record for year after election.
newsitem.headline: Dow powers to 32nd record for year after election.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average thundered Wednesday to its 32nd record for the year in post-election euphoria as Wall Street bet that the status-quo in Washington would keep stocks on their bullish track.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones ended up 96.53 points at 6,177.71. The Standard & Poor's composite index of 500 stocks also set a record, jumping 10.46 points to 724.60.
In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 16-7 on heavy volume of 511 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
